flashcard_questions.q: A hand-drawn or digitally created sketch that shows the planned layout and design of a static media product such as a magazine page, poster, DVD cover, or game interface, including annotations explaining design choices.
A simple, skeletal outline of a web page or app screen that shows the placement of elements such as navigation, headers, content areas and buttons, without colours, images or detailed styling.
The overall experience a person has when interacting with a digital product, including how easy it is to navigate, find content and complete tasks.

flashcard_questions.a: So the team looks at the layout instead of the styling.
flashcard_questions.q: Why are wireframes drawn in black, white and grey only?
